## Contract
Inputs: `suggestion_id` (required), `caller_email`, `caller_name`. Result: `status` (approved | already_decided | forbidden | not_found | error), `skill_id`, `to_version`, `message` (a sentence ready to show). Read flat from the calling node.

## Rules
- Only a caller whose email or name matches `manager_email`/`manager_name` on a `psl_poc` row may approve; otherwise `forbidden`.
- A suggestion that is not pending answers `already_decided`.
- On approve: the skill's `current_version` and prompt become the suggestion's `to_version` and `proposed_prompt`; each evidence ticket in `psl_feedback` becomes resolved with action "Included in <skill> v<n>"; the suggestion becomes approved with approver and time.

Deployed 2026-10-16 (deployed version 2). The approved path has not been run on UAT yet.
